array_semantics.coordinates: xy pixel coordinates; rows use observation.names; image arrays are y,x
array_semantics.anatomical_uv: A-domain B-minus-A displacement; zero outside support is a sentinel, not agreement
array_semantics.triangle_green_strain: 0.5*(F.T@F-I); geometric distortion, not physical tissue deformation
array_semantics.triangle_principal_log_stretch: log singular values of F; invalid triangles excluded by triangle_valid

heldout_residual_vectors.missingness: rows with heldout_fit_supported=false are zero sentinels; failures remain in evidence.json

sensitivity_draws.missingness: rows with sensitivity_draw_supported=false or columns with sensitivity_region_supported=false contain zero sentinels; failed refits withhold intervals

array_semantics.regional_*: seven regional rows in evidence.json regional_comparison; B-minus-A observed displacement; existing A-to-B polar maps; unsupported array slots are zero sentinels; no localization uncertainty propagation
array_semantics.landmark_supported: source-coordinate in-bounds intersection for both observations
array_semantics.flow_admissible: heuristic texture/cycle/overlap support, not correctness probability
array_semantics.edge_*: landmark-guided normal-ray gradient response; offsets are meaningful only where accepted; not independent anatomy or landmark corrections
array_semantics.intrinsic_*: source-chart reference8 relations with uncertain eye-span normalization; arrays use the 256-row registry in intrinsic.json; source axes A,B; missing bounds use explicit masks; no independent votes
array_semantics.structure_*: fourteen named rows in intrinsic.json structural_comparison; same source graph; nominal arrays use observed points; delta is B minus A; unavailable masks retain zero sentinels
array_semantics.localization_*: eight reference-protocol points only; source-ellipse-derived outer gap bounds in the fixed observed coordinate gauge; no extrapolation to 478 points

integrity_limit: self-consistency hashes; not an externally signed execution attestation
